teaser.en: A coastal shrub that shares one name with a neighbour and another with the plants used for arrow shafts.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha pwani kinachoshiriki jina moja na jirani yake, na jina lingine na mimea inayotumiwa kutengeneza mipini ya mishale.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha pwani chinachokala na dzina mwenga na jiraniye, na dzina ranjina sawa na mimea inayohumirwa kutsonga *nyomba*.

summary.en: Mmangwi is a coastal shrub of the coffee family with clusters of small white flowers. Pakia also lists it among the plants called mtsonga nyomba, 'make arrow shaft'.
summary.sw: Mmangwi ni kichaka cha pwani cha familia ya mibuni chenye vishada vya maua madogo meupe. Pakia pia anakiorodhesha miongoni mwa mimea inayoitwa mtsonga nyomba, 'tengeneza mpini wa mshale'.
summary.dg: *Mmangwi* ni chitsaka cha pwani cha jamii ya kahawa, chenye mafungu ga maruwa madide mereru. Pakia piya anauandika kahi ya mimea inayoihwa *mtsonga nyomba*, 'mtsonga nyomba' (mutu anayetsonga *nyomba*).

about.en:
*Mmangwi* is a shrub or small tree of the coffee family (Rubiaceae). It has opposite, glossy leaves with small pointed stipules between the leaf stalks, and many small white, often fragrant flowers in dense clusters at the leaf bases. They are followed by small round berries.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves.
about.sw:
*Mmangwi* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa familia ya mibuni (Rubiaceae). Una majani yanayong'aa yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, yenye vikanzu vidogo vyenye ncha (stipuli) katikati ya vikonyo vya majani, na maua mengi madogo meupe, mara nyingi yenye harufu nzuri, katika vishada vizito kwenye vishina vya majani. Baada yake huja beri ndogo za mviringo.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia walikitambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg:
*Mmangwi* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jamii ya kahawa (*Rubiaceae*). Una makodza ganayomera mairi-mairi ganalolana, ganayong'ala, na vikodza vidide vyenye ntsa kahi ya milita ya makodza (*stipules*). Una maruwa manji madide mereru, mara nyinji genye arufu nono, ganayomera mafungu-mafungu phatu milita ya makodza inaphoandzira. Chisha kunamera matunda madide ga mviringo.

Atu ariomterya Pakia anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket in Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Kinaota katika misitu na vichaka vizito vya pwani nchini Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

uses.en: Pakia lists the species under *mtsonga nyomba*, a name for plants whose straight sticks are used to make arrow shafts.
uses.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha spishi hii chini ya *mtsonga nyomba*, jina la mimea ambayo vijiti vyake vilivyonyooka hutumika kutengeneza mipini ya mishale.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika aina ihi photsi ya dzina *mtsonga nyomba*, dzina ra mimea ambayo fwimbo zayo zigololokazo nkuhumirwa kutsonga *nyomba*.

names.en: Pakia gives two names. *Mmangwi* is shared with *Tricalysia ovalifolia*, and Duruma and Giriama share it too. *Mtsonga nyomba* means 'make arrow shaft', from *tsonga*, to make, and *nyomba*, arrow shafts. That name also covers *Polysphaeria parvifolia*, *Dichapetalum zenkeri*, *Mildbraedia carpinifolia* and *Uvaria lucida*. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa majina mawili. *Mmangwi* linashirikiwa na *Tricalysia ovalifolia*, na Kiduruma na Kigiriama pia hulitumia. *Mtsonga nyomba* maana yake ni 'tengeneza mpini wa mshale', kutokana na *tsonga*, kutengeneza, na *nyomba*, mipini ya mishale. Jina hilo pia linajumuisha *Polysphaeria parvifolia*, *Dichapetalum zenkeri*, *Mildbraedia carpinifolia* na *Uvaria lucida*. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia analavya madzina mairi. *Mmangwi* ni dzina ra *Tricalysia ovalifolia* piya, na Aduruma na Agiryama piya anarihumira. *Mtsonga nyomba* rina mana ya 'kutsonga *nyomba*', kula kpwa *tsonga*, kuhenda (kutsonga), na *nyomba*, fwimbo za mivwi. Dzina hiri piya ni ra *Polysphaeria parvifolia*, *Dichapetalum zenkeri*, *Mildbraedia carpinifolia* na *Uvaria lucida*. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.
